info.name: API Reference Associated Persons plans API

params.name: type
params.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `health_insurance`.

params.name: provider_id
params.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `allianz`, `irish_life_health`, `vitality`, `onvz`, `freedom`, `sanitas`, `canada_life`, `hallesche`, `bupa`, `dansk_sundhedssikring`, `allianz_kpt`, `freedom_uk`.

params.name: available_on
params.description: Filters plans available on a specific date. Defaults to today.

params.name: group_id
params.description: Filters plans by group eligibility. Only plans whose eligibility criteria match the group are returned. Criteria that cannot be evaluated are ignored.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Reference date used to compute employee age when evaluating per-plan eligibility counts. Required together with `group_id` for counts to be included in the response.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

params.name: group_id
params.description: When provided together with `start_date`, per-plan eligibility counts are included in the response. Silently ignored if not paired with `start_date`.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Reference date used to compute employee age when evaluating eligibility. Required together with `group_id` for counts to be included.

items.docs: Retrieves a `plan` object by its ID.
